answer: Make honesty the cheap option. An operator running several agents can declare them as one fleet: they share a pooled reward cap (size is an assumption) but skip extra checks. Undeclared identities later linked by two independent signals lose unvested rewards, so a hidden farm bets its pearl on surviving a canyon of future audits. Evasion: stay hidden if detectors are weak; the carrot only works when audits are credible. Wrongly hit: look-alike strangers, so one signal never counts, links must be shown, not an onyx-black score, and appeals stay open.
